case_title.reason: Title matches the judgment's parties (Union of India & Ors. v. Bodupalli Gopalaswami).

number_of_accused.reason: One accused, the Commandant (respondent no. 1), is tried and dismissed.

accused_gender.reason: Judgment refers to the accused as 'he' and 'the Commandant' throughout; male is supported.

accused_age.quote: the first respondent reached the age of superannuation long ago
accused_age.reason: No age is stated; judgment only says he reached superannuation and the matter is over 20 years old.

accused_religion.reason: Religion is not mentioned anywhere in the judgment.

accused_caste.reason: Caste is not mentioned in the judgment.

accused_occupation.reason: Judgment states he was Commandant of 227 Company ASC (Supply).

previous_criminal_record.reason: No prior criminal record is mentioned.

victim_gender.reason: No victim is identified; offences are military-discipline and fraud-on-government charges.

victim_age.reason: No victim is identified in the judgment.

victim_caste.reason: No victim is identified in the judgment.

victim_religion.reason: No victim is identified in the judgment.

accused_victim_relationship.reason: No victim exists, so no relationship is stated.

offence_category.correct_value: Military offences under Army Act: fraud-type (s. 52(f)) and prejudice to good order and military discipline (s. 63)
offence_category.quote: the first charge was an offence falling under section 52(f) of the Act
offence_category.reason: No homicide is involved; charges concern fraud and military discipline under the Army Act.

statutory_provisions.reason: Army Act ss. 52(f), 63 and Pension Regulation 16(a) are all referenced in the judgment.

weapon.reason: No weapon is mentioned in the judgment.

evidence_type.correct_value: Witness testimony (13 prosecution witnesses), documentary exhibits, and material objects; inspection findings
evidence_type.quote: As many as 13 witnesses were examined. A large number of documents ... apart from three material objects
evidence_type.reason: Omits witness testimony and inspection evidence; 'circumstantial' is not described in the judgment.

confession.reason: Judgment does not mention any confession; 'None' is an inference not stated.

aggravating_circumstances.reason: No aggravating circumstances are expressly stated.

mitigating_circumstances.correct_value: Matter over 20 years old; respondent reached superannuation; charges technical; limited role as overall controlling officer
mitigating_circumstances.quote: having regard to the fact that the matter is more than 20 years old and the first respondent reached the age of superannuation long ago
mitigating_circumstances.reason: Judgment does state mitigating points, as the judicial mitigating factors field itself reflects.

trial_court_outcome.correct_value: General Court Martial imposed dismissal from service; President later forfeited pension by order dated 22.12.1995
trial_court_outcome.quote: the GCM imposed the sentence of dismissal from service on first respondent on 30.7.1993
trial_court_outcome.reason: GCM imposed only dismissal; pension forfeiture was a separate Presidential order, not the trial outcome.

high_court_outcome.quote: the High Court ... quashed the order dated 22.12.1995 forfeiting the pension
high_court_outcome.reason: High Court quashed the pension forfeiture order while upholding dismissal and findings.

final_outcome.quote: the findings of guilt regarding charges (1), (4) and 5(c) ... there is no reason to interfere
final_outcome.reason: Guilt on charges 1, 4 and 5(c) upheld; punishment reduced, so 'convicted' is supported.

offence_finally_established.correct_value: Offences under s. 52(f) and s. 63 of the Army Act (charges 1, 4 and 5(c))
offence_finally_established.quote: The other two charges which are held to be proved relate to acts or omissions ... punishable under section 63
offence_finally_established.reason: Culpable homicide is not an established offence; proved offences are Army Act fraud and discipline offences.

imprisonment_type.correct_value: Not stated (no imprisonment imposed; punishment was forfeiture of 8 years' service for pension and severe reprimand)
imprisonment_type.quote: forfeiture of eight years of service for the purpose of pension; and (b) Severe reprimand
imprisonment_type.reason: No imprisonment was imposed; the substituted punishment was forfeiture of service and reprimand.

imprisonment_years.quote: forfeiture of eight years of service for the purpose of pension
imprisonment_years.reason: Eight years refers to forfeiture of service for pension purposes, not imprisonment.

fine_rs.reason: No fine is mentioned in the judgment.

neutral_facts.correct_value: Neutral facts should omit the Supreme Court's outcome (setting aside dismissal and substituting lesser punishment)
neutral_facts.quote: the Supreme Court set aside the dismissal and substituted it with a lesser punishment
neutral_facts.reason: Facts reveal the court outcome, which neutral_facts must not do; other facts are broadly accurate.

offence_severity.quote: imprisonment for a term which may extend to ten years ... imprisonment for a term which may extend to seven years
offence_severity.reason: Maximum terms under s. 52(f) (ten years) and s. 63 (seven years) match the judgment.

attempt_completion.reason: Charged conduct is treated as completed acts or omissions; 'Completed' is consistent with the judgment.

physical_harm.reason: No injury or death is mentioned; the charges concern meat quality and procedure.

number_of_offences.correct_value: 5 charges framed; 3 charges (1, 4, 5(c)) found proved and upheld
number_of_offences.quote: The first respondent ... was also issued a charge-sheet ... containing the following charges
number_of_offences.reason: Five charges were framed, not three; the GCM found three proved, which the Supreme Court upheld.

financial_property_loss.correct_value: Not stated (no loss amount); charge alleged intent to defraud government
financial_property_loss.reason: Fraud-on-government allegation exists, so 'Not applicable' is inaccurate; no quantified loss is stated.

premeditation_planning.reason: Premeditation is not discussed in the judgment.

motive.reason: No motive is established; the charge alleged intent to defraud without identifying motive.

key_evidence_accepted.quote: heart was an edible offal and could be issued on demand of units and also reiterated the said observation in his confidential report
key_evidence_accepted.reason: Accurately reflects the accepted observation evidence and the absence of instruction evidence.

witness_credibility.reason: Judgment does not assess witness credibility; the inference from subordinates being punished is not a credibility finding.

post_offence_conduct.correct_value: Respondent reiterated his observation in confidential report dated 15.2.1990
post_offence_conduct.quote: reiterated the said observation in his confidential report dated 15.2.1990
post_offence_conduct.reason: Judgment records a post-inspection act (confidential report reiterating the observation), not 'Not stated'.

trial_duration.quote: The trial commenced on 22.1.1993 and concluded on 30.7.1993.
trial_duration.reason: Listed dates are for the High Court and Supreme Court decisions, not the trial duration.

legal_representation.quote: P.P. Malhotra, ASG, Rajiv Nanda, Rahul Kaushik, B.K. Prasad (for B.V. Balaram Das) for the Appellants
legal_representation.reason: Counsel names match the appellant and respondent listings in the judgment.

investigation_status.quote: a direction for trial of the first respondent by General Court Martial
investigation_status.reason: Charge sheet issued and GCM trial completed; consistent with the judgment.

procedural_irregularity.correct_value: Plea of Presiding Officer's disqualification was raised but rejected; no procedural irregularity found
procedural_irregularity.quote: the act of summarily trying others for other offences relating to the same incident is not a ground of disqualification
procedural_irregularity.reason: A procedural irregularity was alleged and rejected; 'None noted' omits the raised plea.

appeal_history.correct_value: HC partly allowed writ and quashed pension forfeiture; Union appealed (Crl. A. 876/2003), respondent appealed (Crl. A. 877/2003); SC allowed both
appeal_history.quote: The High Court by judgment dated 25.8.2000 allowed the writ petition in part
appeal_history.reason: Trial_court entry misdescribes the High Court writ; high_court entry mixes in Supreme Court outcome.

prosecution_argument.correct_value: Not stated (judgment does not record the appellants' arguments)
prosecution_argument.reason: Judgment does not record counsel's arguments; the stated position is inferred rather than recorded.

defence_argument.correct_value: Respondent contended procedural irregularity, perverse findings, and shockingly disproportionate punishment
defence_argument.quote: that in spite of his challenge, it was not set right and therefore, the entire Court Martial proceedings ... were vitiated
defence_argument.reason: Respondent argued findings were perverse, not 'not perverse'; he challenged procedure and proportionality.

legal_principle_applied.quote: the power to deny pension as a consequence of an officer being cashiered or dismissed or removed from service, vests only with the President of India under Regulation 16(a)
legal_principle_applied.reason: Matches the Court's stated principle on Regulation 16(a) and independence from court-martial punishment.

precedent_relied_upon.correct_value: P.D. Yadav (relied); Major A. Hussain (relied); Ranjit Thakur (relied); R.K. Sharma (referred); Brig. A.K. Malhotra was reversed, not relied upon
precedent_relied_upon.quote: Brig. A. K. Malhotra v. Union of India (1997) (4) SLR 51 - stood reversed in P. D. Yadav
precedent_relied_upon.reason: Brig. A.K. Malhotra is listed as relied upon but the Court held it reversed; R.K. Sharma was only referred to.

sentencing_rationale.quote: the punishment of dismissal from service is shockingly disproportionate to the gravity of the offences held to be proved
sentencing_rationale.reason: Accurately reflects the reasoning for substituting a lesser punishment.

judicial_mitigating_factors.quote: the charges in so far as the first respondent were technical in nature
judicial_mitigating_factors.reason: Court considered technical nature of charges, limited role and subordinates' omissions.

judicial_aggravating_factors.reason: Judgment does not expressly state that no aggravating factors exist; 'None' is an inference.

other_sentence_order.quote: The respondents are directed to process and settle his pension claim within six months
other_sentence_order.reason: Pension settlement direction and denial of back-wages both match the judgment.
